//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Random Village Names -> Config

Enable Random Village Names.//: Whether Random Village Names is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

customVillageNames.//: Your own village names, one per line in the config screen. A village gets a random name from this list, together with Collective's names when 'useCollectiveVillageNames' is enabled.

useCollectiveVillageNames.//: Whether villages can also get a name from Collective's built-in list, which is editable in ./config/serilum/collective/area_names.json.

useEachNameOnce.//: If enabled, a village name is only used again once every name has been given to a village in that dimension.

placeSignsUnderground.//: If enabled, the village name sign is placed underground below the village center, where it can't be broken by accident. Areas still finds it.

undergroundSignDepth.//: How many blocks below the surface the sign is placed when 'placeSignsUnderground' is enabled. min: 1, max: 10
